prompt: Estimate nutrition for the meal described. Preserve explicit portions, units, and nutrition-label values. For unspecified portions use typical US servings. Return a short meal name (3-6 words), calories in kcal, and protein, fiber, carbs and fat in grams. Values must be nonnegative; preserve decimals. Use null for an unknown nutrient, never invent zero. Return only the requested JSON fields; no explanations.
